scope: anyUnitDamaged dispatcher bytecode-level control-flow inventory; callee bodies and native engine behavior are outside full-closure claim

semantics.registerRoles: r0 source after pc2; r1 target after pc29; r2 attributed tower after pc30/pc51; r3 scratch/snapshot damage. Low registers before these PCs have temporary meanings.
semantics.instructionControlFlow: Lua 5.3 EQ/LT/LE skip next iff result != A; TEST skip next iff truthiness != C; JMP direct; FORPREP direct; FORLOOP has loop/exit successors.
semantics.readableExpressions: Block-local provenance only. No cross-block substitution or symbolic execution. rN denotes value at block entry. RET@pc is open result list; B=0 expansion preserved. Repeated expressions in descriptions do not repeat runtime calls.
